description: Language-neutral layout spec for the emojig picker. Consumed by the Zig app. Grid sizes are clamped at load time to the compile-time bounds in src/defaults.zig (5–16 columns, 3–16 rows) — those bounds only size stack buffers; the values here are the actual defaults (env EMOJIG_COLS/ROWS and the cols=/rows= config lines override them per user).

animation.description: Controls the exit-fade (block-shade preview) animation. exit_preview_tui applies when running inline in a terminal (TUI mode); exit_preview_gui applies when launched as a floating window (GUI mode). Set either to false to skip the animation and exit immediately on selection. exit_preview_steps is the number of block-shade frames; exit_preview_ms is the hold duration. The EMOJIG_EXIT_PREVIEW env var and EMOJIG_EXIT_PREVIEW_MS override these defaults at runtime.
